description: Angular component for managing users, including listing users and creating new users with interactions to an API service.

classes.name: UsersComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for displaying and managing users, implementing OnInit lifecycle hook.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by loading the list of users from the backend.

methods.name: loadUsers
methods.description: Fetches all users from the API and updates the users signal.

methods.name: toggleCreateForm
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the user creation form.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user using form input, adds to the user list upon success.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the newUser form fields to default empty strings.
